# Epitome — Ceylon Specialty Coffee

> Single-origin Ceylon specialty coffee from the central highlands of Sri Lanka. The essence of Ceylon coffee.

## What Epitome is

Epitome is a Sri Lankan house for single-origin Ceylon specialty coffee: highland Arabica, roasted to order. One product: Epitome — a 500 g bag of whole-bean, medium-roast, single-origin Sri Lankan Arabica.

## Origin

Sri Lanka's reputation was written in tea. Before that, the island was Ceylon coffee — once among the world's great origins, then nearly lost to leaf rust and the pivot to Camellia (tea). Higher still, in the central highlands, a quieter crop has been tended for generations: Arabica, grown between 1,200 and 1,800 metres, where nights are cool and the morning sits in mist.

What remains is scarce on the global map: specialty lots from shade-grown Kandyan gardens — coffee beside pepper, clove, and nutmeg — not from monoculture plains. The Ceylon name already travels. The bean does not need a blend to introduce itself.

Epitome is that crop, kept as a single expression. No blend to soften the soil. No second roast to hide a fault. Chocolate depth, vanilla warmth, and a clean stone-fruit finish — the character of highland Sri Lanka, packed in one black-and-gold bag.

Ceylon Arabica sits in a balanced middle against the giants: less polarizing than Ethiopia's floral, high-acid cups, with more sweetness and spice than a standard washed Latin lot. Moderate acidity, a silky body — honest as pour-over, structured enough for espresso. Epitome works with farming families on those slopes and roasts in small lots after you reserve. What reaches you is not warehouse coffee — it is the current harvest, roasted for the cup you will actually drink.

### Terroir
- Origin: Central Highlands, Sri Lanka
- Gardens: Shade-grown Kandyan polyculture
- Altitude: 1,200–1,800 m
- Cup: Moderate acidity · silky body

## The coffee

- Varietal: 100% single-origin Arabica
- Roast: Whole bean · medium
- Notes: Dark chocolate · vanilla · stone fruit
- Acidity: Bright, clean, balanced
- Net weight: 500 g
- Brew methods: Pour-over, espresso, French press, moka, cold brew

## Brew ritual (pour-over)

1. Eighteen grams — freshly ground, medium-coarse for pour-over, finer for espresso.
2. Water at 93 °C — just off the boil.
3. The bloom — pour 50 ml and wait 35 seconds.
4. A slow spiral — the remaining 250 ml in calm circles, three to four minutes.

## How to buy

There is no warehouse stock. Reserve a bag on the site; the house confirms by email within a day, then arranges payment and ships. Product of Sri Lanka.

## Wholesale & hospitality

For cafés, hotels, and restaurants — Epitome by arrangement. Whole-bean, roasted to order, in the volumes your house needs. Wholesale & hospitality pricing on request; private labelling available.
